description: Run a deterministic swing-sensitivity sweep over the active user-controlled scenario and return the modeled control curve, swing-to-flip values, and most sensitive races.

level.description: Default senate. "house" sweeps all 435 seats around the 218-seat majority line.

simulation_id.description: Optional. Sweep from this scenario's modeled margins instead of the static 2024 baseline; un-modeled races fall back to baseline.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: exposure
